description: This script fetches S&P 100 tickers, downloads historical stock data, computes technical indicators (SMA), performs clustering (KMeans and Gaussian Mixture), visualizes clusters, and analyzes cluster characteristics.

methods.name: fetch_sp100_tickers
methods.description: Fetches S&P 100 tickers from Wikipedia page.

methods.name: download_stock_data
methods.description: Downloads historical stock data for given tickers from Yahoo Finance.

methods.name: add_technical_indicators
methods.description: Calculates and adds technical indicators like SMA to the data.

methods.name: perform_clustering
methods.description: Performs clustering using KMeans and Gaussian Mixture models on technical indicators.

methods.name: plot_clusters
methods.description: Visualizes clusters based on SMA indicators.

methods.name: analyze_clusters
methods.description: Analyzes and summarizes characteristics of each cluster.
